mismatches.reason: The predicate only requires acceptance when the fee exceeds the rejection threshold, whereas the statement says fees within MAX_FEE_CAP should be accepted, including those at or below 100,000.
The predicate encodes fee rejection (not accepted) but never encodes falling back to basic tick spacing fees, the actual stated consequence.

V asserts the fee is not accepted while I asserts acceptance for the same within-cap above-threshold case, but V omits the fallback-to-basic-fees impact and I's scope is misstated, so the intended violation is not cleanly captured.
